errors.evidence: The color-to-value mappings are incorrect. The correct mappings are: orange represents 57.1%, blue represents 23.8%, and red represents 19%. The description also misidentifies the red color as yellow ('жълто').

errors.evidence: This statement about the relative sizes of the sectors is incorrect. The largest sector is the orange one (57.1%), not the blue one (23.8%). The correct order of size is orange > blue > red.
The description omits a word from the legend label. The correct label is "Да, защото са икономически по-изгодни", where "по-" means "more".
